h1: Just for Fun Main and Carriage
meta_description: Just for Fun is a renovated, pet-friendly Seaside retreat with a private carriage house, watchtower, Gulf views, bikes, and steps to the beach and pools.
description_expanded: This beautiful corner unit home is the best of location and design. When you step inside, you are reminded of the sleek styling of a teak-trimmed sailboat. The second floor is open and airy, with brilliant natural light bathing the main living area and tall ceilings. All new plush furniture decorates the living room along with a large Smart TV and Sonos sound system.
